in_marathi.name: Chidambaram
in_marathi.meaning: हिंदू नाव म्हणजे Lord of the Cosmos
in_marathi.long_meaning: Chidambaram हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Chidambaram is a Sanskrit name derived from the Tamil word 'Chidambaram', meaning 'Lord of the Cosmos'. This name is associated with Lord Shiva and is often used to refer to the temple town of Chidambaram in Tamil Nadu, India, which is famous for its temple dedicated to Lord Shiva.
